taylor_mc: Heads-up for tomorrow's 3pm panel — candidate has requested a screen-share demo and may join from a company Mac. Can someone confirm AV + recording consent?

elena: I can bring the Mac dongles and test screen share at 2:45. Is the plan to record? candidate consent needed.

taylor_mc: @jess_recruiter flagged they gave verbal consent but we need explicit Slack confirmation + the checkbox in the form. I'll paste the Zoom link and the debrief form below.

interview-bot: Recording policy reminder — please ensure candidate consent is captured in the debrief form.

ben_g: Re: scribe — I can take notes if someone else can manage the recording flow. Quick ask: do we want separate tech vs systems rubrics, or one combined score?

samir_patel: I'd prefer separate anchors (tech / system design / collaboration) so we can weight later. For this role, suggest weights: tech 50%, system 30%, collaboration 20%.

jess_recruiter: Confirmed candidate consent in-thread: "I consent to the session being recorded for hiring purposes." Copy of consent emailed too.

taylor_mc: Perfect. Zoom: https://zoom.company.com/j/123-456-7890 (passcode in calendar). Debrief form: https://intranet/redwood/debriefs/xyz — scribe, use the "Highlights" section for open feedback.

ben_g: Small nit: can we add a 5-min rubric anchor at the start to align panel? I can host a 5-min sync at 2:55.

elena: +1, will join for the anchor. I'll also test screen share at 2:45 and ping here when done.

taylor_mc: Awesome — plan: 2:45 AV check (elena), 2:55 5-min rubric anchor (ben), 3:00 candidate joins, ben scribe, record on consent captured. Thanks all :raised_hands:

interview-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30 minutes until meeting.
